scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" --kill-others --success first "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload" "cd frontend && ng serve"
scripts.sync: concurrently -n "API_SYNC,WEB_INSTALL" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && uv sync && uv run app/init_database.py" "cd frontend && npm install"
